papers.title: Evaluating Rational Contracting in Natural Language
papers.titleZh: 评估自然语言中的理性缔约
papers.abstract: The emergence of language-based AI agents promises to transform the scope of machine economic activity. Instead of just proposing bids or following hard-coded protocols, such agents can be used to negotiate and execute agreements in open-ended natural language. However, most evaluations of these abilities have focused on one-off exchanges or simple economic games, leaving open the rich space of time-extended, contingent, and incomplete contracts made expressible by language; they also focus on raw profit, without measuring the qualities required for trustworthy contracting. We address this by formulating a rational framework for how agents should negotiate and perform natural language contracts in uncertain multi-step environments. Within this framework, we develop metrics and baselines for quantifying rational and cooperative play. To evaluate how agents perform at such contracting, we instantiate our framework in ContractSim, an evaluation suite where two players negotiate and execute a multi-turn supplier contract under environmental and inter-player uncertainty. Across six environments and three supplier settings (catering, hotel cleaning, and AI hosting) we find that current LLM-based agents reach agreement reliably, and negotiate efficient contracts when environmental uncertainty is low. However, under high uncertainty, they often fail to negotiate satisfiable, efficient, or mutually beneficial contracts. They are also frequently uncooperative when executing contracts, violating contract terms for additional profit even when contracts are easy to satisfy. These findings highlight room for improvement in the design of language agents that can negotiate, interpret, and execute contracts both rationally and cooperatively.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 随着大语言模型驱动的AI智能体日益自主，它们有望参与复杂的经济活动并以自然语言协商长期、动态的合同。然而，现有研究多关注一次性交易或固定协议，缺乏对时间延伸、条件性和不完全合同的有效评估。本文旨在填补这一空白，探究当前语言智能体能否理性且合作地谈判并执行这类真实世界中常见的复杂合同。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 作者构建了一个名为CONTRACTSIM的评估框架，将缔约过程形式化为一个两阶段博弈：谈判阶段由两个基于LLM的智能体通过自然语言协商达成合同；执行阶段则在一个带有环境不确定性的随机环境中履行合同。合同被解析为对联合策略的约束，智能体的目标是在满足合同条款的前提下最大化自身效用，同时考虑对方的履约情况。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 研究发现，在低不确定性环境下，LLM智能体能够达成高效且互惠的合同。但在高不确定性下，它们常无法协商出可满足或互利的合同。更严重的是，在执行阶段，即使合同易于履行，智能体也频繁单方面违约以谋取私利，表现出高度不合作性。这表明当前智能体尚不具备可靠、理性的缔约能力。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 为量化智能体表现，作者提出了理性基线模型，包括理性履约者（RC）、理性剥削者（RE）和理性条件履约者（RCC），用于衡量合同质量和履约行为。通过将自然语言合同自动解析为形式化约束，并计算智能体相对于基线的效用、合规率和违约行为，实现了对缔约全过程的定量评估。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 该研究局限于特定供应商场景和预设的履约基线，且未解决如何训练智能体达到理想行为的问题。尽管如此，其价值在于首次系统性地评估了LLM在复杂合同任务中的表现，揭示了现有模型在合作性上的根本缺陷，为未来开发更可靠的AI经济代理提供了重要的评测框架和方向指引。

papers.title: Non-Existence of EFX Chore Allocations for Monotone Cost Functions with Binary Marginals
papers.titleZh: 单调二元边际成本函数下无嫉妒至任何任务（EFX）家务分配的非存在性
papers.abstract: We study the existence of envy-free up to any item (EFX) allocations of indivisible chores when agents have monotone cost functions with binary marginals. For indivisible goods, the corresponding existence question is known to have an affirmative answer for general monotone functions with binary marginals. For chores, however, the existence of EFX allocation was previously known only for more restricted classes, while the general binary-marginal case remained unresolved. In this paper, we provide two counterexamples based on the same 18-agent, 53-chore word gadget, with one cost profile for binary XOS costs and another for binary supermodular costs. In both cases, a complete EFX allocation need not exist. Finally, we formalize and verify our main results in Lean 4.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 本文探讨在不可分家务分配中是否存在满足‘无嫉妒至任何任务’（EFX）的公平分配方案。尽管对于物品分配，已知在二元边际条件下EFX总是存在的，但对于人们希望避免的任务——即‘家务’，该结论是否成立仍是开放问题。尤其在更一般的单调二元边际成本下，EFX的存在性此前未被解决。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型考虑n个代理与一组不可分的家务，每个代理拥有一个单调且具二元边际的成本函数，即增加一项任务最多使成本增1。EFX要求：任一代理在移除自己任一任务后不再嫉妒他人。研究聚焦两类特定函数：二元XOS（两个加法函数的最大值）和二元超模函数，并考察其在18代理、53任务实例中的行为。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文证明，在上述两类成本函数下，完整的EFX分配可能不存在。通过构造两个基于相同任务集合的反例，分别针对二元XOS和二元超模成本函数，展示了即使在结构良好、具有清晰组合意义的函数类别中，EFX也无法保证存在，从而填补了该领域的重要理论空白。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者采用组合反例构造方法，利用循环移位生成53个18位二进制字符串作为任务。关键在于设计一个图论性质——对任意不超过9个坐标的子集，其投影图的最大匹配大小严格小于坐标数。此性质与EFX条件结合，导致矛盾，从而排除EFX分配的可能性。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结果依赖于精心构造的反例，其结构特殊，未必反映常见场景。然而，这恰恰突显了EFX在非加法情境下的脆弱性。最值得阅读的是其精巧的组合构造与对公平性边界的新认知，尤其是将图论性质嵌入公平分配证明的技术路径，为后续研究提供了新工具。

papers.title: The Game of Marginal Utilities
papers.abstract: We study a noncooperative resource-allocation game in which $m$ players distribute fixed resources among $n$ projects and the payoff of player $j$ is given by \[ F^j(x) = \sum_{i=1}^n \frac{a_i x_i^j}{b_i+\sum_{\ell=1}^m x_i^\ell}, \] where $a_i$ and $b_i$ are project parameters, while $x_i^j$ is the amount of resources player $j$ allocates to project $i$. This specification combines diminishing returns with congestion generated by competitors. We prove that the game has a unique Nash equilibrium and characterize it by an equimarginal principle. We show that, after the projects are ordered by $a_i/b_i$, each player invests in an initial segment of projects, and these segments are nested across players, so the equilibrium decomposes into consecutive activity zones; players with larger resources invest weakly more in every project. In the fully active regime, where every player invests in every project, we reduce the equilibrium to a single scalar nonlinear equation for the aggregate marginal-utility rate; all individual marginal rates, investments, and payoffs then follow from explicit formulas. We also provide a projected marginal-utility algorithm with global linear convergence under an explicit step-size condition, together with a structure-exploiting \textit{Block Pandora} algorithm that reconstructs and certifies the equilibrium conditional on a proposed nested cutoff structure.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 本文研究战略决策者如何在共享项目间分配固定资源，其中投资带来收益但竞争会稀释回报。这类问题出现在人工智能、能源等领域的投资博弈中。现有比例分配模型在无基线时无法解释零投资和分层参与现象，本文旨在填补正基线下的均衡结构空白，揭示资源不均如何导致项目参与的嵌套截断。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型包含m个玩家和n个项目，每个玩家将固定资源分配至项目以最大化自身收益。项目i的收益由参数ai和基线bi决定，玩家j的效用为∑aixij/(bi+∑xij)，体现递减回报与竞争稀释。策略空间为非负分配向量且总和等于资源量，均衡采用纳什均衡概念，核心挑战在于活动项目的内生性和边际效用的相互影响。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文证明该博弈存在唯一纳什均衡，并基于质量比qi=ai/bi排序项目，发现玩家按资源多少嵌套地投资前k个项目，形成连续活动区。在全活跃情形下，通过一个标量非线性方程求解聚合边际效用率，进而显式还原所有个体决策与支付。此外提出两种算法：全局收敛的投影边际效用法和利用嵌套结构的Block Pandora重构认证法。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者运用Rosen的凹博弈理论验证存在唯一性，利用KKT条件导出等边际原则作为均衡特征。关键技巧是引入有效边际水平并证明其继承项目质量序，从而建立截断结构。对于全活跃情形，通过聚合变量降维至单一方程。算法设计上结合变分不等式与投影映射，利用强反单调性和Lipschitz性质保证收敛性。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 模型假设所有玩家共享相同项目参数，限制了异质偏好场景的应用；结果高度依赖理性函数形式，推广到一般凹函数尚不明确。尽管如此，论文对基线引发的结构性变化提供了清晰刻画，其嵌套截断与区域分解思想具有启发性。最值得阅读的是均衡结构分析、标量降维技巧及两种互补算法的设计逻辑。

papers.title: To EFX OR to MMS, That is the Question
papers.titleZh: To EFX OR to MMS, That is the Question
papers.abstract: We study the agent-wise disjunction of two central fairness notions for indivisible items, where every agent must be either envy-free up to any item (EFX) or maximin-share (MMS) satisfied. One might expect this flexibility to restore existence, especially because the existence of EFX itself resisted resolution for nearly a decade. Surprisingly, it does not. We construct counterexamples with three agents and eight submodular goods, and with three agents and seven submodular chores, significantly strengthening recent EFX impossibility results. On the positive side, we prove existence for additive mixed items with at most three valuation types when one type is a singleton. Our proof extends beyond additivity for goods and yields approximation schemes for goods and three-agent chores instances. We also identify a clean separation between the disjunction and its constituents: For additive chores with two valuation types, EFX and MMS are both known to fail, whereas an EFX$\vee$MMS allocation always exists. Finally, we show that identical additive valuations even admit the conjunction EFX$\wedge$MMS for mixed items. Overall, our results show that allowing flexibility in choosing agent-specific fairness certificates expands the frontier of fair solutions while also uncovering surprising impossibilities.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么即使放宽公平标准，某些分配仍无法满足基本公平？本文探讨在不可分物品分配中，EFX（去任意一项无妒忌）与MMS（最大最小份额）两种主流公平准则的联合可行性。尽管两者各自已知可能不存在，人们期望允许每个代理任选其一作为保障能恢复存在性，但该文挑战了这一直觉。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型考虑一组代理对不可分物品的估值，物品可为商品、任务或混合项。每个代理需被满足EFX或MMS之一。设定涵盖加法、次模、单调估值，并区分商品与任务场景。关键在于个体化公平证书的选择自由度，而非全局统一准则，从而形成比传统更强的存在性检验。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文证明这种宽松组合仍可能失败：构造出三个代理、八个次模商品或七个次模任务的反例，其中无人能同时满足任一准则。这显著加强了现有不可能性结果。正面结果则显示，在至多三种估值类型且一类仅含一个代理时，加法混合项下总存在解。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 负向结果通过SMT求解器搜索并辅以人工结构验证，结合几何秩变换确保次模性。正向结果采用离散切分-选择协议，利用阈值保持的EFX重划分子程序，结合极大极小份额分割与偏好选择逻辑来构造分配。算法部分提供伪多项式及近似方案。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 反例依赖精细构造，未必反映典型实例难度；正向结果局限于特定类型分布。然而，论文清晰揭示了两类公平原则互补性的边界，其模型抽象与技术组合极具启发性。最值得阅读的是其结构性反例、阈值保持转换技巧及对公平证书灵活性的根本反思。

papers.title: A Consolidated Game Framework for Cooperative Defense Against Cross-Domain Cyber Attacks in Satellite-Enabled Internet of Things
papers.titleZh: 面向卫星赋能物联网中跨域网络攻击的协同防御统一博弈框架
papers.abstract: As the adoption of satellite-enabled Internet of Things (IoT) continues to rise, its intricate multidomain architecture becomes increasingly susceptible to cross-domain cyber threats. Attackers can exploit compromised IoT devices, inject malicious packets into data streams aggregated at the IoT gateway for satellite backhaul, and potentially endanger the satellite network during transmission by exploiting the hardware, software, and protocol vulnerabilities. Compared to single-domain defenses, cooperative defense at the IoT devices, IoT access network, and satellite transmission network provides fine-granularity defense against cross-domain intelligent attacks. However, quantifying cross-domain impacts and tilting incentive misalignment among different participants remain significant challenges, making systematic cooperative defense development a complex task. To address this, we develop a tripartite security game framework to characterize the impacts of attacks and defense methods across both the terrestrial and satellite domains. Leveraging this game model, we devise flow pricing to optimally motivate the IoT network operator (IoT-NO) to prevent malicious packet infiltration into the satellite domain. Subsequently, we propose efficient learning algorithms enabling both the IoT-NO to ascertain their ideal flow sampling strategies and the satellite service provider (SAT-SP) to determine optimal flow pricing. The simulation results corroborate the effectiveness of the consolidated game in counteracting cross-domain cyber attacks and facilitating cooperative defense between the IoT-NO and the SAT-SP with nonaligned incentives.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 随着卫星赋能物联网的发展，攻击可从地面物联网设备发起并影响卫星网络，形成跨域威胁。由于不同运营方（如物联网运营商与卫星服务商）目标不一致，缺乏激励共享信息或主动防御，导致单域防护效果有限。本文旨在解决如何量化跨域影响，并通过机制设计协调多方在信息不对称下的协同防御难题。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文构建了一个三方博弈模型，包含攻击者、物联网网络运营商（IoT-NO）和卫星服务提供商（SAT-SP）。攻击者决定恶意流量注入率，IoT-NO选择个体流采样频率进行检测，SAT-SP配置粗粒度防御策略。各方效用受跨域行为耦合影响，模型引入混合策略下的联合均衡概念——整合Stackelberg-Nash均衡（CSNE），刻画了多层次交互与激励错配。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出了CSNE均衡的存在性条件及其双线性规划求解方法，揭示了采样频率对防御配置的阈值效应：当采样不足时，卫星端需提升防御强度；否则可采用低成本策略。进一步发现安全效率比的临界值受设备重装率影响，体现了跨域风险传导。数值结果表明该框架能有效提升合作防御收益，最大效用增益达11.9%。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者利用Stackelberg结构建模地面攻防互动，并结合Nash博弈描述运营商间的策略对抗。针对参数未知场景，将IoT-NO的学习建模为多臂赌博机问题，提出基于UCB的高效采样策略学习算法；对SAT-SP的价格学习，则利用效用关于价格的分段线性特性，设计有限步收敛的自适应搜索算法，显著提升学习效率。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 模型假设攻击仅通过数据包注入传播，未考虑更复杂的多阶段或隐蔽攻击；价格机制由SAT-SP单方面设计，未扩展至双向谈判。尽管如此，论文在跨域安全激励建模、均衡结构分析及学习算法设计方面具有高阅读价值，尤其适合关注多主体安全协作、机制设计与实际部署可行性的读者深入研读。

papers.title: VIScore: Diagnosing Planning-Relevant Quality in Latent World Models
papers.titleZh: VIScore: 诊断潜在世界模型中与规划相关的质量
papers.abstract: Regulating the latent space to an isotropic Gaussian distribution provides a stable and information-maximized landscape for world model planning. However, the latent space property and successful planning remain disconnected. We first study this by comparing SIGReg and VISReg, two regularization loss functions with the same distribution target but different properties. Compared with SIGReg, VISReg has more flexibility in controlling the weights of center, scale, and shape regularization, and a larger batch size brings a finer distribution approximation. We find that the former, despite being beneficial in self-supervised learning (SSL), does not help the planning, whereas the latter improves the planning success on out-of-domain (OOD) datasets. This motivates a deep understanding of the factors that correlate with the success rate. Unlike the previous metrics focusing on the encoded latent only, we propose the Veracity-Influence-Sobriety score (VIScore), a metric that quantifies the reachability and capacity of a predictor given the encoded feature, and the hallucination of the searching-based planner. Compared with straightness, physical-state probing, and empowerment, we show that, with the measurement covering encoder, predictor, and planner, VIScore explains the success rate better than the others, as reflected by a strong Spearman correlation. Specifically, VIScore consistently achieves a Spearman correlation over 0.75 on both seen and unseen models and datasets on the cross-task success rate pool. Moreover, VIScore is the only metric that has a calibration error below the constant fit across all testing scenarios, showcasing the importance of these three aspects in planning success. We hope this metric can help future studies on world model design and diagnosis.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 现有世界模型虽能稳定训练，但潜空间质量与实际规划成功率之间缺乏可靠关联。以往指标如轨迹直线性或物理状态可探测性仅关注编码器输出，忽略了预测器和规划器在执行过程中的交互影响，导致无法解释为何某些模型在相同潜分布下规划表现差异显著，尤其是在域外或长视野任务中。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究基于端到端联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），通过替换正则化损失函数（SIGReg vs VISReg）进行受控实验，并在多个视觉控制任务上评估不同训练阶段的检查点。核心设定是将成功规划定义为在真实环境中达到目标状态，并使用外部成功率作为验证标准来衡量诊断指标的有效性。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 提出VIScore，首个综合评估编码器、预测器与规划器协同质量的诊断指标。该指标由真实性、影响力和清醒度三个因素构成，其乘积与跨任务、跨方法、跨数据集的成功率呈现强斯皮尔曼相关性（>0.75），且校准误差低于常数基线，显著优于现有单一维度指标。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: VIScore从三个方面量化规划可靠性：真实性衡量开环 rollout 误差是否在任务容忍范围内；影响力将潜空间赋能转化为任务所需的最小容量阈值；清醒度检测搜索型规划器是否会过度利用预测误差虚构更优动作。三者共同捕捉不可达动态、容量不足与幻觉利用三类互补失效模式。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: VIScore不适用于无预测器的摊销式规划器，且对依赖离散状态转换的任务（如抓取闭合）敏感度低。尽管相关性强，高分不绝对保证成功。最值得阅读的是其诊断框架的设计逻辑与跨设定验证协议，为未来世界模型开发提供了可解释的质量分析工具而非单纯性能预测器。

papers.title: GESTO: Human-Centric Spatio-Temporal Memory for Reasoning in Dynamic Scenes
papers.abstract: Robots operating in human environments need memories that capture not only what objects exist and where, but also how people use them over time and how individual interactions compose into goal-directed activities. Existing 4D scene graphs preserve object and place histories but omit activity structure, whereas activity representations are either not grounded in persistent 3D scenes or rely on externally provided event boundaries and object associations. We present GESTO (Grounded Event and Spatio-Temporal memOry), a spatio-temporal memory that couples a persistent 4D scene graph with a two-level hierarchy of atomic human--object interactions and goal-driven events. From an RGB-D observation stream, GESTO automatically extracts timestamped interactions, grounds them to persistent scene entities, groups them into events, and uses event context to refine uncertain object associations. A relation-aware tool-calling agent queries the resulting memory for activity-centric spatio-temporal reasoning. We evaluate GESTO on the reproducible text, binary, and time categories of an existing benchmark, together with 40 new Space2Event and Event2Space queries. GESTO achieves scores of 0.71, 0.75, and 0.70 on the standard categories, approaching a method supplied with ground-truth event and object grounding, while substantially outperforming the same reasoning framework when these inputs are removed. It further achieves 0.73 and 0.75 on Space2Event and Event2Space queries. Ablations show that hierarchical event structure and context-aware grounding refinement provide complementary benefits, supporting activity-grounded hierarchical memory for retrospective reasoning in dynamic human environments.

papers.title: Dual Stress: Runtime Safety Monitoring for Safety-Constrained MPC Navigation
papers.titleZh: Dual Stress: 面向安全约束MPC导航的运行时安全监控
papers.abstract: Runtime hazard monitors for autonomous naviga- tion are conventionally built from geometric quantities: predicted clearance, time to collision, and required deceleration. A model-predictive controller that enforces safety through explicit con- straints computes, as a by-product of every control step, a second information channel that such monitors ignore: the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker multipliers of its constrained optimization, which measure the marginal control effort spent to maintain safety against each obstacle. This paper evaluates whether a horizon-weighted sum of those multipliers, a dual stress signal, provides a hazard monitor complementary to the geometric warnings the same state already supports. We compare it against a battery of fifteen geometric detectors tuned to a matched false-alarm budget, on preregistered held-out crossing scenarios driven through a physics simulator. The stress alarm actionably flags 4.7 times as many collisions missed by the entire geometric battery as the geometric battery flags in return (85 versus 18); combined, the two channels warn of three quarters of the collisions for which braking remained feasible, against under half for the geometric battery alone.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 自动驾驶中基于模型预测控制（MPC）的安全导航通常依赖几何量（如距离、碰撞时间）进行危险预警，但这类方法在动态复杂场景下可能反应滞后。本文指出，MPC求解过程中产生的对偶变量——KKT乘子——蕴含了控制器为维持安全所付出的边际代价，却被现有监控系统忽略。问题在于：能否利用这一被忽视的信号构建更有效的运行时安全监测机制？
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究在一个物理仿真环境中测试六车交叉交通场景，控制器采用带安全约束的MPC（CBF-MPC），其对偶变量被实时提取形成‘对偶应力’信号。对比基线是一个由15个几何探测器组成的综合检测系统，两者在相同误报预算下评估。输入为车辆状态，输出为是否触发警报，评价标准是能否在可行刹车截止前发出可行动警告。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出‘对偶应力’作为新的运行时安全信号，实验证明其显著补充了几何监控的不足。在2000个预留测试场景中，对偶应力单独捕获了85次即将发生的碰撞，而几何系统仅捕获18次；联合使用可覆盖四分之三的可避免碰撞。物理反事实测试显示，响应应力报警刹车可避免96.5%的碰撞，证明其因果可用性。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 对偶应力定义为MPC各步安全约束对应的KKT乘子在时间轴上的加权和，反映控制器为规避每个障碍物所承受的优化压力。该信号不依赖额外计算，直接读取已有求解结果。其有效性源于对‘逃脱难度’而非‘接近程度’的敏感性，在近距离、高动态冲突中表现优于基于恒定速度外推的几何方法。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结论局限于固定参数的仿真环境，障碍物为匀速运动，未考虑真实感知噪声或交互式交通。传感器退化会削弱信号优势，且未进行端到端因果控制实验。尽管如此，论文清晰展示了对偶变量作为监控信号的潜力与边界，最值得读的是其问题设定、机制验证方式及对运行时安全监控的新视角。

papers.title: Lost in Reconstruction: Aligning Action Representations with Language in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.titleZh: 迷失于重建之中：在视觉-语言-动作模型中对齐动作表示与语言
papers.abstract: Action verbs describe not only the physical outcomes of actions, but also how those actions are performed. Yet action representations in vision-language-action models (VLAs) are typically optimized for reconstruction under L1/L2 losses in raw action space, where numerical proximity need not reflect linguistically meaningful distinctions. On BridgeV2, we show that action trajectories contain verb-grounding information beyond visual state changes, and that reconstruction-only discrete tokenization systematically erodes this information. To address this problem, we introduce SALT, a Semantically ALigned action Tokenizer that augments a VQ-VAE-style tokenizer with an auxiliary objective requiring a frozen vision-language model to recover the episode instruction from quantized action latents. Policies trained with SALT achieve 71.9% average success in SimplerEnv, compared with 42.7% for a reconstruction-only VQ-VAE tokenizer and 31.2% for FAST. SALT also develops verb-specialized codes while maintaining reconstruction fidelity. These results show that robot action trajectories provide a source of language grounding and that preserving this structure in action representations can substantially improve language-conditioned control.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 现有视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）通常通过低维动作空间的数值重建来学习动作表示，但这忽略了语言中动词所表达的执行方式差异。由于动词不仅描述目标状态变化，还包含运动模式、接触时机等动态特征，仅依赖L1/L2损失的重建方法会抹除这些语义信号，导致语言与动作之间的对齐断裂，限制了语言条件下的精细控制能力。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文在BridgeV2数据集上研究动作轨迹如何承载动词语义，并评估不同动作分词器对语言信息的保留能力。输入是机器人操作的动作序列和自然语言指令，输出是离散动作标记。通过互信息分析衡量标记与动词的关联性，并在SimplerEnv中测试策略部署成功率，比较VQ-VAE、FAST和提出的SALT分词器的效果。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 提出SALT——一种语义对齐的动作分词器，通过引入辅助目标使冻结的语言模型从量化动作潜变量中恢复原始指令，从而在不牺牲重建质量的前提下增强语言相关结构的保留。实验显示，使用SALT的策略在SimplerEnv中达到71.9%的成功率，显著优于重建-only方法，且动词解码性能更高，证明动作表示应同时支持执行与语言对齐。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: SALT基于VQ-VAE架构，在训练时增加一个生成式对齐损失：将多个动作块的量化潜变量作为前缀输入冻结的预训练语言模型，要求其生成对应的自然语言指令。该损失通过直通估计器反向传播，引导编码器和码本划分出更符合语言抽象的动作单元。此方法无需定义动词词典或对比负样本，直接利用自由文本进行监督。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结论受限于BridgeV2中动词多样性不足，且SALT目前仅适用于可学习潜空间的分词器，难以扩展至固定分箱或频域压缩方法。大规模真实部署效果尚待验证。最值得阅读的是其对‘动作表示需兼顾可执行性与语义结构性’的设计理念，以及用生成式对齐压力提升下游性能的轻量级干预思路。

papers.title: Deployment Is Not Destiny: Robot Recomposition in the Field with Unseen Software, Hardware, and Compute Payloads
papers.titleZh: 部署并非宿命：现场对未知软件、硬件与计算载荷的机器人重组
papers.abstract: The tight coupling of subsystems in most robots, though a natural consequence of their complexity, leads to monolithic designs that are time-consuming and difficult to adapt after initial deployment. To address this challenge, we present a framework and supporting abstractions for recomposition during runtime that enable robots to quickly integrate previously unseen modular software, hardware, and compute payloads. Our approach allows non-expert users to quickly add new capabilities in the field through a true plug-and-play process. Crucially, new resources are not only immediately available to a host robot but are also shared with distributed peers, enabling compute-constrained systems to access powerful new remote capabilities. Our framework reduces reconfiguration time to a matter of minutes with no developer intervention, in stark contrast to the hours of expert effort often required for traditional manual integration. We demonstrate our method in two disaster response scenarios, including radioactive source localization at an operational nuclear reactor facility and a thermal-guided search for people in dark, difficult-to-reach spaces. These demonstrations show how in-field recomposition provides timely, flexible, and accessible adaptation to dynamic requirements, representing a critical step toward creating robots that can quickly evolve alongside the tasks, technologies, and environments they support.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 传统机器人一旦部署便难以更改功能，因软硬件高度耦合导致重构需专家介入且耗时漫长。当任务需求突变或新设备出现时，现有系统缺乏快速适应能力。本文针对这一刚性瓶颈，探索如何让非专业用户在野外环境中无需编程即可即时集成未知的新模块，实现真正即插即用的运行时重组。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究设定围绕机器人在执行任务过程中动态接入从未预知的软件、硬件和外部算力载荷。输入是自然语言任务指令与物理连接的模块，输出是由行为树自动生成并执行的任务计划。系统通过自动发现、加载与共享组件，在多种主机机器人上验证其跨平台适应性与实时响应能力。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出一个支持开放模块集的运行时重组框架，首次实现无需重启、无需开发者干预、自动共享与组合新能力的全流程。两个真实场景演示——放射源定位与热成像搜救——展示了分钟级重构能力和跨机器人复用性，证明了系统在动态环境中快速扩展功能的可行性与实用性。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 核心方法基于统一的组件抽象模型，将软件（Docker容器）、硬件（USB设备）和算力（网络节点）封装为可发现、可管理的‘非所见即所得’模块。组件管理器监听设备插入、网络信号与系统事件，自动加载镜像、交换数据库，并利用PDDL规划器结合行为树动态生成任务执行流程，使新增能力立即参与决策。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 局限在于载荷选择、安装正确性及物理配置仍依赖人工判断，且当前使用非反应式规划器限制了动态调整能力。尽管如此，该工作为构建真正灵活的现场机器人提供了可落地的系统蓝图，最值得阅读的是其问题设定与端到端的即插即用机制设计。
